name: Granola landing page by granola.ai
description: An editorial landing page built on a cream ground (#FAF8F1) with a large serif display face doing almost all the persuasive work — headlines run to full-viewport width ('For the doers', 'Works everywhere you do'). The page alternates rhythm deliberately: light hero and hairline-divided feature rows, then a giant type statement, a near-black logo band, a chartreuse chat band, dark testimonial cards, and back to light. Every product claim is evidenced by a macOS-style window mockup with cream notepad UI, often composited over landscape photography. It closes with a multi-column footer that dissolves into an enormous full-bleed wordmark.
